development_replays.outcome_unit: percentage points of reported HbA1c (%) for error; assay standardization unavailable
development_replays.index_rule: protocol 9-month visit with all four named visits present

development_replays.clock: released shifted draw dates; collection proxy
development_replays.index_rule: end of fourth distinct released draw day; within-person same-day median
development_replays.target_tiebreak: closest to 90, then earlier released day

numeric.population: One index per source-scoped person per task. Separate measured Hb and HbA1c tasks.
numeric.prediction_index: inclusive as-of cutoff; future outcomes joined after forecasting
numeric.unsupported_time_basis: label retrospective proxy or reject when true as-of is required

first_development_challenger.slope: median distinct-date pairwise slope per day
first_development_challenger.span: s = last day minus first day
first_development_challenger.point_formula: last + slope * h * (-expm1(-1)) * min(1, s / h)
first_development_challenger.finite_negative_output: retain raw for diagnostic, flag invalid; any serving fallback needs a distinct version

numeric.hypothesis_scope: separate estimates per cohort and analyte; external superiority not prespecified
numeric.primary_score: mean of per-person differences in absolute error (candidate minus last) on common observed targets, with denominator and coverage
secondary: fallback and physically invalid output counts
calibration intercept and slope when estimable

corrected_bootstrap_proposed.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64); record exact version and subject ordering

numeric.event_endpoint: first documented qualifying result after landmark in defined at-risk participants; use only where ascertainment and support are defensible
numeric.public_reports: aggregate only; site-specific release rules and suppression assessed before export
numeric.interval_split: One primary case per person. Disjoint deterministic per-person calibration and evaluation subsets; algorithm and sample counts recorded in each scorecard.

development_decision: Maintain persistence as reference. Retain raw and fallback counts. Advance a new model per task only if its development paired MAE improves on persistence without hiding failures. Report descriptive comparisons; no clinical superiority threshold defined.

mimic_demo.role: optional schema and return-window feasibility in an overlapping 100-person subset; never a held-out hospital performance claim
mimic_demo.label: Hemoglobin
mimic_demo.clock: released chart date and store time; history available by end of fourth usable chart day
mimic_demo.eligibility: four distinct chart days with numeric routine hemoglobin available by that same day end
mimic_demo.followup: later chart day 76 through 104 inclusive with numeric result; duplicates reduce to presence for counts
mimic_demo.encounter_scope: all documented hospital laboratory events for this item including records without hadm_id; pre-transfusion exclusions unavailable in demo feasibility
mimic_demo.future_full_mimic: exclude every demo participant from future independent full-release test
